fact: A survey of health facilities run between September 2022 and April 2023 found six public-sector electronic patient records, three of them electronic consultation registers and three deployed in two university hospitals, only one of which covers almost the whole patient file, and states that computerised patient records are lacking in the public system; the Ministry of Health's information systems department, created in 2018, is charged with the national electronic patient file, the State budget carries no dedicated provision for digital health, and 89% of funding comes from technical and financial partners and the private sector.
title: Current status of digital health interventions in the health system in Burkina Faso
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
